families.axis: quiet intellectual depth → penetrating depth of mind or feeling

members.gloss: marked by depth of thinking
members.tone: Plain, unshowy praise that locates the depth in the thinking itself rather than in the person's habit of it, as *thoughtful* does.

members.gloss: showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth
members.tone: The strongest of these and the widest, crediting either a mind that cuts through or a feeling that runs deep, where *deep* and *thoughtful* stay with the intellect.

members.gloss: having intellectual depth
members.tone: Mild, steady approval for possessing intellectual depth, without the reach *profound* claims.

families.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

members.gloss: make conspicuous or noteworthy
members.tone: The only member that raises its object rather than merely labelling it, conferring either conspicuousness or the status of being worth remark, where *mark* just designates.

members.gloss: designate as if by a mark
members.tone: The plain designating verb, working by figure as readily as by an actual mark and passing no judgement on what it singles out.

members.gloss: indicate by marking trees with blazes
members.tone: Literal where *mark* is figurative: the sign is cut into trees, so the word carries its instrument and nothing evaluative.

members.gloss: mark with a buoy
members.tone: The whole force of the word sits in the marker it names, so it points a thing out without commenting on it.

members.gloss: indicate the dimensions on
members.tone: Technical and flatly informative — what it puts on a thing is measurements, with none of the singling-out for notice that *distinguish* carries.

families.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

members.gloss: a mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something (especially on a person's body)
members.tone: Names the spoiling mark as a fault, so the thing carrying it is judged wanting rather than merely marked.

members.gloss: a mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something (especially on a person's body)
members.tone: Keeps the damage at the level of appearance — the thing is spoiled to look at, where *defect* calls it faulty.

members.gloss: an indication of damage
members.tone: The flattest word here: it registers that damage happened and passes no verdict, where *scar* insists the damage lasted.

members.gloss: a blemish resulting from a break without complete separation of the parts
members.tone: Graver than *chip* or *scratch*, since the break runs through the thing and only the parts still holding together keep it whole.

members.gloss: a mark left after a small piece has been chopped or broken off of something
members.tone: Something is gone rather than merely marked, and the word makes the loss sound abrupt.

members.gloss: (pathology) a firm abnormal elevated blemish on the skin; caused by a virus
members.tone: Clinical naming for a raised growth, but abnormality is built into it — not the plain report *mole* makes.

members.gloss: an impression in a surface (as made by a blow)
members.tone: The surface has given way under a blow without breaking, so nothing is lost and it stays milder than *chip*.

members.gloss: an indication of damage
members.tone: Damage dragged across a surface — broader than *scratch* and still shallow.

members.gloss: a small congenital pigmented spot on the skin
members.tone: Purely descriptive: a pigmented spot carried from birth, with no suggestion of damage or fault.

members.gloss: an indication of damage
members.tone: The slightest indication of damage in the set — thin and superficial where *scar* is permanent.

members.gloss: an indication of damage
members.tone: The heaviest of the damage words: the harm is over but permanently recorded, where *scratch* passes.

members.gloss: an impression in a surface (as made by a blow)
members.tone: Informal and belittling — the same blow-struck impression as *dent*, named in a way that makes light of it.

members.gloss: a place or area that has been burned (especially on a person's body)
members.tone: Names the place by the violence that made it, which gives it a weight *mark* has not.

members.gloss: a blemish on the skin that is formed before birth
members.tone: Traces the blemish to birth rather than to any injury, so nothing is blamed for it.

members.gloss: a mark left after a small piece has been chopped or broken off of something
members.tone: The colourless name for the same loss *chip* reports, with none of the sound of breaking in it.

members.gloss: an impression in a surface (as made by a blow)
members.tone: Smallest of the impressions, and the word makes the blow sound trifling where *dent* concedes real force.

members.gloss: a skin lesion that is a diagnostic sign of some disease
members.tone: Clinical and grave: the lesion is not merely present but read as evidence, the skin testifying to a disease.

families.axis: a woman placed beside a powerful man → a woman named as adulterous

members.gloss: an adulterous woman; a woman who has an ongoing extramarital sexual relationship with a man
members.tone: The censure is inside the definition rather than added by the speaker, since the word names the relationship as adulterous and ongoing; where *concubine* marks a living arrangement, this marks a breach.

members.gloss: a woman who cohabits with an important man
members.tone: A term of position rather than accusation: it fixes a woman by the household she shares and the standing of the man in it, saying nothing about marriage being broken.

families.axis: a false belief dismissed as a light notion → a false idea condemned as hollow and unworkable

members.gloss: something many people believe that is false
members.tone: The gentlest way to call a widely held belief false, treating the error as a passing notion rather than an indictment of anyone holding it.

members.gloss: something many people believe that is false
members.tone: Sharper than *fancy*: the false belief is cast as something wished into being, so holding it looks like self-indulgence rather than a slip.

members.gloss: an impracticable and illusory idea
members.tone: Adds unworkability to falseness — the idea is not only illusory but could never be carried out, and the word keeps the burst inside it.

families.axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

members.gloss: a female person who is a fellow member of a sorority or labor union or other group
members.tone: Turns fellow membership of a sorority, a union or any other group into a family tie between women, warmer than the bare enrolment *member* records.

members.gloss: a member of a learned society
members.tone: Membership as conferred standing — a learned society's name for one of its own, where *member* would only note that someone belongs.

members.gloss: one of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participate in a group organization)
members.tone: The flat term for one of the people a group is composed of, joining and taking part included but no warmth or rank added.

members.gloss: someone accepted for membership but not yet fully admitted to the group
members.tone: Names a person by an admission still unfinished, accepted but held short of the settled standing *member* assumes.

members.gloss: having characteristics that attract love or affection
members.tone: The family's plain baseline - it says the thing has whatever draws love, without dressing the quality up as innocence or sweetness.

members.gloss: having characteristics that attract love or affection
members.tone: The full-spelt form, identical in warmth and force to *lovable*.

members.gloss: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
members.tone: Superlative where *lovable* is merely descriptive - affection is not attracted but compelled, and the childlike or naive streak is what compels it.

members.gloss: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
members.tone: Puts the effect in motion rather than the quality at rest: it wins affection over, where *adorable* simply announces the winning is done.

members.gloss: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
members.tone: Broad, easy warmth for the same childlike appeal, without the surrender *adorable* implies.

members.gloss: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub
members.tone: Lifts sweetness to an ideal - praise that leaves no room for a fault in the nature described.

members.gloss: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub
members.tone: The extended form of *angelic*, reaching for the same unblemished sweetness with a more formal ring.

members.gloss: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub
members.tone: Takes the cherub rather than the angel: sweetness that is small, round and fond instead of exalted.

members.gloss: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub
members.tone: The most rarefied of the angel words - sweetness raised to something radiant and remote, well past the homely warmth of *cherubic*.

members.gloss: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub
members.tone: The unadorned name for the nature the angel words put wings on - the same quality with none of the exaltation.

members.gloss: inviting cuddling or hugging
members.tone: Carries the invitation in its build - a thing that asks to be held, stated more deliberately than *cuddly*.

members.gloss: inviting cuddling or hugging
members.tone: Soft, offhand and physical: the appeal is being huggable, not being good-natured as in *sweet*.

families.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

members.gloss: according with custom or propriety
members.tone: Warm approval - what accords with custom is credited with grace rather than mere compliance, unlike the dry *decorous*.

members.gloss: according with custom or propriety
members.tone: Gentle and pleased - it finds conduct agreeable in its accord with propriety rather than measuring it against a rule.

members.gloss: according with custom or propriety
members.tone: A phrase rather than a word, and formal to the point of ceremony - approval delivered by invoking the code instead of describing the conduct.

members.gloss: according with custom or propriety
members.tone: Cool and external - conduct is held up against a standard of propriety and passes, with none of the warmth of *becoming*.

members.gloss: according with custom or propriety
members.tone: Understated - grants that conduct accords with propriety without the ceremony *decorous* brings to the same verdict.

members.gloss: socially right or correct
members.tone: Approval as a verdict - the social rule was met, and nothing warmer than that is claimed.

members.gloss: socially right or correct
members.tone: The bluntest way to render the same social judgement as *correct*, carrying no formality at all.

members.gloss: in harmony with the spirit of particular persons or occasion
members.tone: Approval keyed to the occasion and the people in it rather than to any code - it praises harmony where *correct* praises compliance.

members.gloss: in harmony with the spirit of particular persons or occasion
members.tone: Modest and human - it grants that a thing suits the persons and the moment, with less deliberation than *fitting*.

members.gloss: proper or legitimate according to Muslim law
members.tone: A designation rather than a compliment - it states that something is proper or legitimate under a named law, and the approval belongs to that law and not to the speaker.

members.gloss: proper or legitimate
members.tone: Informal and reassuring - declares a thing proper or legitimate, above board and open to no objection.

members.gloss: exaggeratedly proper
members.tone: Contemptuous - the excess of propriety is read as self-satisfaction, correctness worn as superiority over others.

members.gloss: exaggeratedly proper
members.tone: The lightest fault in this group - propriety held so tightly it stiffens, mocked rather than condemned.

members.gloss: exaggeratedly proper
members.tone: Dismissive and faintly ridiculing - the overdone propriety is treated as fussiness, silly rather than severe like *priggish*.

members.gloss: exaggeratedly proper
members.tone: Propriety inflated into squeamishness - more disapproving than *prim*, since the excess is taken as a readiness to be shocked.
